templates.name: Pool
templates.description: Quarterly pool water quality, equipment, and safety equipment inspection.

steps.label: Check pool water level, clarity, and temperature.
Check and record pool chemical levels in the pool log.
Inspect ladders, cove molding, and rescue equipment.
Vacuum and brush pool surfaces as needed.
Verify required pool signage is posted.

templates.name: Elevator Checklist
templates.description: Monthly elevator preventive maintenance and safety checklist. Assign this template to each applicable elevator or elevator equipment area.

steps.label: Inspect elevator condition, pits, and tracks; clean as needed.
Test fire recall, safety phone, and emergency lighting.
Inspect elevator/pump rooms for cleanliness and access.
Complete applicable elevator safety checks for the property.

templates.name: Administrative Offices
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.

templates.name: Fire Extinguishers
templates.description: Monthly fire extinguisher inspection. Assign this template to all applicable property locations; long-term vendor testing is managed separately.

steps.label: Inspect each extinguisher for condition, proper placement, and charge.
Inspect cabinets, brackets, and hoses; clean as needed.
Confirm inspection tags are current.

templates.name: Building Exterior
templates.description: Triannual building exterior/envelope inspection covering finishes, openings, seals, and visible deterioration. Assign to the property exterior or primary building area.

steps.label: Inspect exterior walls, finishes, trim, and architectural surfaces for damage, deterioration, staining, cracks, or water intrusion.
Inspect exterior doors, windows, frames, sealants, and penetrations for visible damage or deterioration.
Inspect exterior-mounted building signage, lighting, vents, and fixtures for damage or loose components.
Inspect the immediate building perimeter for conditions affecting the building exterior.

templates.name: Parking Lot & Grounds
templates.description: Quarterly parking lot and grounds inspection covering pavement, sidewalks, striping, site fixtures, lighting, landscaping, and drainage.

steps.label: Inspect parking lot and drive areas for potholes, cracks, deterioration, standing water, or other damage.
Inspect sidewalks, curbs, ramps, and walking surfaces for damage, uneven areas, or trip hazards.
Inspect striping, accessible parking markings/signage, wheel stops, bollards, exterior lighting, and other site fixtures for condition and proper operation.
Inspect landscaping, grounds, and drainage areas for overgrowth, irrigation issues, erosion, blockage, or other visible deficiencies.

templates.name: Corridors (Hallways)
templates.description: Quarterly corridor and hallway condition inspection by floor.

steps.label: Inspect condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.

templates.name: Boilers / Water Heaters
templates.description: PM Water Heaters #1, #2, #3, #4

steps.label: Inspect the unit for leaks, proper temperature, and normal operation.
Drain the tank bottom valve until clear water is present.
Inspect the pressure relief valve and circulation pumps.
Clean the burner assembly as applicable.
Verify hot-water temperature at a guest room (about 120–125°F max).

templates.name: Dining & Breakfast Area
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for the dining and breakfast area.

steps.label: Inspect the area for condition, cleanliness, damage, lighting, signage, and other visible deficiencies.
Inspect tables, chairs, counters, and service fixtures for damage or loose components.
Test GFCI outlets for proper operation.

templates.name: Dumpster Area
templates.description: Quarterly dumpster area inspection covering cleanliness, enclosure condition, and surrounding maintenance needs.

steps.label: Inspect the dumpster area for trash, debris, stains, spills, and odors.
Inspect enclosure, gates, hinges, and latches for condition and operation.
Inspect walls, pavement, curbs, and surrounding area for damage.
Clean and pressure wash as needed.

templates.name: Employee Breakroom
templates.description: Preventative Maintenance

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.

templates.name: Employee Restroom
templates.description: Quarterly public restroom area inspection covering finishes, fixtures, plumbing, accessibility hardware, ventilation, and drains.

steps.label: Inspect the restroom for overall condition, damage, lighting, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect toilets, urinals, sinks, faucets, drains, and exposed plumbing for leaks or improper operation.
Inspect partitions, grab bars, counters, mirrors, dispensers, and restroom fixtures for damage or loose components.
Inspect caulk, grout, flooring, and drains for deterioration, water issues, or odors.
Clean/inspect exhaust ventilation and verify proper operation.

templates.name: Boiler/Water Heater Room
templates.description: PM Hot Water Heater Room

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.
Verify electrical panels and disconnects are properly labeled.
Keep the room clear and organized for safe access.

templates.name: Electrical Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly electrical room area inspection covering room condition, ventilation, combustibles, and panel filler blanks.

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.
Verify exhaust ventilation is pulling air properly.
Ensure no combustibles are stored in the room.
Inspect panels for open or missing breaker blanks; install approved fillers as needed.

templates.name: Emergency Lights
templates.description: Quarterly emergency lighting inspection covering lamp operation, test buttons, and battery condition.

steps.label: Inspect emergency lights and replace failed lamps as needed.
Test each unit with the test button and verify battery charge.

templates.name: Relay
templates.description: Quarterly relay and beacon device battery and alarm function inspection.

steps.label: Inspect and test relay/beacon devices for proper operation.
Replace beacon batteries as needed.
Verify device locations and status in the admin portal.

templates.name: Engineering Shop
templates.description: Quarterly engineering shop inspection covering room finishes, organization, and cleanliness.

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.
Organize tools and equipment for safe use and access.

templates.name: Entry Foyer
templates.description: Quarterly entry foyer inspection covering finishes, doors, locks/intercom, luggage cart parking area, and exterior entrance surfaces.

steps.label: Inspect entrance area, doors, frames, glass, lighting, signage, and hardware for condition and proper operation.
Test applicable locks, intercoms, and automatic entrance-door operation.
Inspect mats, walking surfaces, curbs, and the immediate entrance area for damage or trip hazards.
Inspect luggage cart parking area and entrance fixtures for condition.
Clean glass and pressure-wash exterior entrance hardscape as needed.

templates.name: Public HVAC / Common Area AC Units
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for common-area HVAC / AC units, with each unit tracked as its own PM item.

steps.label: Inspect overall operation for unusual noise, vibration, leaks, icing, or visible damage.
Inspect and clean/replace the air filter as needed.
Inspect evaporator and condenser coils; clean as needed.
Clean and vacuum the condensate drain line and inspect the drain pan.
Inspect accessible electrical, refrigerant lines, belts, and moving components for visible problems.
Verify thermostat/control operation and proper unit operation.

legacyNames: Front Desk - Public Space VTEC Unit

templates.name: Fire System Flow
templates.description: Quarterly fire system flow and contracted inspection tracking checklist.

steps.label: Confirm contracted alarm-panel inspection is current.
Confirm contracted standpipe/hose testing and maintenance is current.
Confirm contracted wet-pipe sprinkler testing and maintenance is current.
Confirm contracted fire-hydrant flow test is current.
Confirm contracted backflow-prevention assembly testing is current.

templates.name: Fitness Center
templates.description: Quarterly fitness center area and equipment preventive maintenance.

steps.label: Inspect fitness center condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect fitness equipment for proper operation, loose/damaged parts, cords, and connections.
Test door lock and guest key access.

templates.name: Roof
templates.description: Quarterly roof and building-area inspection covering surface condition, flashing, drainage, access, ventilation, and shingle areas where applicable.

steps.label: Inspect roof surfaces for damage, deterioration, ponding water, or excessive wear.
Inspect seams, flashing, penetrations, parapets, curbs, and sealants for visible deficiencies.
Clean roof drains, scuppers, gutters, and accumulated debris where applicable.
Inspect walk pads, roof access, and visible ventilation components.
For shingled areas, inspect shingles and fasteners for visible damage or deterioration.

templates.name: Rooftop Exhausts
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop exhaust fan preventive maintenance. Add additional exhaust items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect exhaust fan operation for damage, unusual noise, vibration, or buildup.
Inspect and clean fan wheel/blades, guard, motor, and accessible components.
Inspect belts/pulleys where equipped for wear, tension, and alignment.
Inspect electrical/control wiring and dampers for visible problems and proper operation.
Inspect accessible ductwork/connections for damage or water intrusion.

templates.name: Rooftop Units
templates.description: Quarterly rooftop unit (RTU) preventive maintenance. Checklist steps to be added later. Each RTU item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect overall unit condition and operation for unusual noise, vibration, or damage.
Inspect and clean/replace filters as needed.
Inspect accessible coils, drains, electrical, and moving components for visible problems.

templates.name: Housekeeping Carts
templates.description: Quarterly housekeeping cart inspection covering wheels, hardware, and finish.

steps.label: Inspect carts for overall condition, damage, loose components, and safe operation.
Inspect wheels/casters and tighten, lubricate, or replace as needed.
Tighten loose hardware, handles, shelves, and supports as needed.
Clean carts and touch up damaged finishes as needed.

templates.name: Luggage Carts
templates.description: Monthly luggage cart inspection covering wheels, hardware, carpet/platform, bumpers, and finish.

steps.label: Inspect cart for overall condition, damage, loose components, and safe operation.
Inspect wheels/casters and tighten, lubricate, or replace as needed.
Tighten loose hardware, handles, rails, and supports as needed.
Inspect carpet/platform and bumpers; clean or secure as needed.
Clean and polish cart surfaces as needed.

templates.name: Water Softener
templates.description: Quarterly water softener inspection covering condition, salt/brine levels, hardness, leaks, and normal operation.

steps.label: Inspect the water softener for leaks, corrosion, damage, or abnormal conditions.
Check salt/brine tank condition and levels.
Test water hardness.
Inspect accessible piping, valves, and drain lines for leaks or drainage problems.
Verify normal operation with no alarms or error conditions.

templates.name: Refrigerators / Freezers / Coolers
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for refrigerators, freezers, buffet coolers, and similar self-contained refrigeration equipment. Each unit keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect and clean the unit; check doors, hinges, gaskets, and seals.
Verify proper temperature and airflow.
Inspect and clean condenser/evaporator coils as needed.
Clean the condensate pan/drain and check for leaks or blockage.
Inspect cord, plug, controls, and overall operation for visible problems.
Clean underneath/behind the unit and verify normal operation.

templates.name: Chlorine Feeders
templates.description: Semiannual chlorine feeder inspection and routine maintenance. Assign to the pool equipment room or applicable chemical feed area.

steps.label: Inspect feeder condition, lid, seals, fittings, and connections.
Inspect input/output hoses for leaks, cracks, or loose connections.
Clean accessible components as needed.
Verify the feeder appears to be operating normally.

templates.name: Juice Machine
templates.description: Quarterly juice machine inspection covering operation, electrical connections, leaks, and sanitation.

steps.label: Inspect and clean the machine exterior, dispensing area, and accessible components.
Inspect cord, plug, electrical connections, and controls for visible damage or improper operation.
Inspect condenser/ventilation areas for dirt or buildup and clean as needed.
Inspect for leaks, damage, unusual noise, or other signs of improper operation.
Verify normal operation after maintenance.

templates.name: Ice Machines
templates.description: Quarterly ice machine inspection covering operation, drains, condenser, leveling, ice quality, filter, and sanitation.

steps.label: Inspect overall condition and operation of the ice machine.
Inspect drain lines, condenser coils/fins, and unit level; clean as needed.
Inspect accessible electrical connections, ice quality, and the water filter.
Clean and sanitize accessible ice-making components and bin as needed.

templates.name: Commercial Dishwasher / Sanitizer
templates.description: Monthly preventive maintenance for commercial dishwashing and sanitizing equipment.

steps.label: Inspect the unit for condition, cleanliness, and proper operation.
Inspect accessible cord, connections, hoses, and piping for damage or leaks.
Check water supply and verify wash/rinse temperatures are in range.
Clean accessible screens, spray arms, nozzles, filters, and drains as needed.
Delime as needed and run a complete test cycle.

templates.name: Commercial Dryer
templates.description: Preventive maintenance for commercial dryers. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Inspect the dryer for damage, unusual noise, vibration, or abnormal heat.
Clean under/behind the unit and remove lint from accessible areas.
Inspect and clean accessible exhaust duct and vent for lint buildup.
Inspect cord, connections, door, and lint screen.
Run a complete cycle and verify proper operation.

templates.name: Commercial Washing Machine
templates.description: Quarterly preventive maintenance for commercial washing machines. Each unit keeps independent completion and maintenance history.

steps.label: Inspect the machine for damage, excessive vibration, or unusual noise.
Clean drain trough/lint trap and inspect hoses, valves, and chemical lines for leaks.
Inspect accessible wiring, belts, and mechanical components for wear or damage.
Clean accessible equipment areas of dust, lint, and debris.
Run a test cycle and verify proper fill, wash, drain, and extraction.

templates.name: Laundry Room
templates.description: Quarterly laundry room area inspection covering finishes, utilities, linen chute, and restricted access.

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, electrical components, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect and clean accessible lights, pipes, and room fixtures as needed.
Inspect linen chute where installed for damage, obstruction, cleanliness, and proper door operation.
Verify the room remains secure and restricted to authorized access.

templates.name: Property Lighting & Signage
templates.description: Quarterly property-wide interior and exterior lighting and signage inspection.

steps.label: Inspect applicable lighting for proper operation, condition, cleanliness, and proper aiming/focus.
Inspect signage for damage, deterioration, visibility, and secure mounting.
Check for vegetation or other obstructions affecting lighting or signage.
Verify applicable exterior lighting controls/timers operate appropriately for dusk/dawn conditions.

templates.name: Linen and Storage Rooms
templates.description: Quarterly linen and storage room area inspection covering finishes, shelving, plumbing, and clear access.

steps.label: Inspect room condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, outlets, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect shelving and cabinets for damage, loose components, or unsafe conditions.
Inspect applicable sinks, plumbing, and drains for leaks, damage, or drainage problems.
Clean accumulated dust/debris from fixtures, shelving, door jambs, and other maintenance-related areas as needed.

templates.name: Guest Dryer
templates.description: Quarterly guest dryer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run dryer through a complete cycle; verify heat and no excessive noise or vibration.
Clean around/behind the unit and inspect for damage or loose components.
Vacuum and clean accessible exhaust duct/vent; remove lint as needed.
Inspect cord, connections, door, and lint screen.

templates.name: Guest Washer
templates.description: Quarterly guest washer preventive maintenance for guest laundry.

steps.label: Run washer through a complete cycle; verify fill, wash, drain, spin, and no excessive noise or vibration.
Inspect hoses, connections, and door/lid seals for leaks or damage.
Clean around/behind/under the unit and dispensers/drain areas as needed.
Inspect cord, controls, door/lid, and exterior.

templates.name: Lobby & Front Desk
templates.description: Quarterly lobby, front desk, and market area public-space inspection.

steps.label: Inspect lobby/front desk condition, including walls, floors, ceilings, lighting, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect front desk, cabinetry, laminate, counters, and furnishings for damage or deterioration.
Test applicable outlets, locks, and intercom equipment.
Inspect lobby furniture and fixtures for damage, loose components, or excessive wear.

templates.name: Vacuums
templates.description: Quarterly vacuum cleaner inspection and service. Add additional vacuum items as needed; each item keeps independent history.

steps.label: Inspect vacuum, hose, attachments, wheels, and housing for damage or excessive wear.
Inspect power cord, plug, and switches for damage and proper operation.
Clean hose/intake passages and remove clogs or obstructions.
Clean and inspect brush roll/beater bar, belt, and roller components where equipped.
Clean/replace bags and filters as applicable.
Test-run and verify proper suction and operation.

templates.name: Meeting Room
templates.description: Quarterly meeting room area inspection covering finishes, flooring, AV/equipment, locks, and HVAC.

steps.label: Inspect meeting room condition, including walls, ceilings, lighting, doors, hardware, and furnishings.
Inspect/test installed screens, whiteboards, projectors/A/V equipment, phones, and applicable connections.
Verify locks and HVAC are operating properly.
Inspect flooring for stains, wear, damage, or trip hazards; deep clean carpet or hard flooring as needed.

templates.name: Outdoor Furniture
templates.description: Quarterly outdoor furniture inspection for pool and fire pit seating areas.

steps.label: Inspect furniture for damage, excessive wear, loose components, or instability.
Tighten accessible hardware and clean furniture as needed.
Inspect finishes for fading, peeling, rust, corrosion, or water deterioration.
Reseal/waterproof only when needed based on material and finish condition.
Verify furniture is safely positioned and in good condition.

templates.name: Pool/Spa Circulation Pump
templates.description: Quarterly pool/spa circulation pump inspection covering mounting, flow, strainer, seals, wiring, and exterior condition.

steps.label: Inspect pump and motor for condition, secure mounting, and normal operation.
Verify proper water flow and check for unusual noise or vibration.
Clean the pump basket/strainer and remove debris.
Inspect housing, lid, seals, piping, and connections for leaks or deterioration.
Inspect accessible electrical components and clean exterior buildup as needed.

templates.name: Pool/Spa Filter
templates.description: Quarterly pool/spa filter inspection covering housing, pressure, valves, media service/backwash when applicable, flow, and exterior cleaning.

steps.label: Inspect filter, piping, valves, fittings, and connections for leaks or damage.
Check pressure gauge and verify normal operating pressure for the installed system.
Clean/service the filter as appropriate for the installed filter type.
Inspect accessible filter components, seals, clamps, and hardware for wear or damage.
Verify proper water flow and normal filtration operation.

templates.name: Pool Heater
templates.description: Quarterly pool heater inspection covering shutoffs, ignition, pipes, fans, and burners.

steps.label: Inspect heater condition, shutoffs, ignition, and burners; clean burners as needed.
Inspect piping, intake/exhaust fans, and outgoing temperature.
Verify pool water temperature is in the expected range.

templates.name: Phone/TV/Computer Room
templates.description: Quarterly phone/TV/computer room area inspection covering finishes, temperature, access, cleanliness, and equipment clearance.

steps.label: Inspect the room for overall condition, cleanliness, lighting, outlets, and visible damage.
Verify room temperature is 75°F or below.
Inspect door, lock, and hardware.
Ensure equipment/panels remain accessible with adequate clearance and ventilation.

templates.name: Public Restrooms
templates.description: Quarterly public restroom area inspection covering finishes, fixtures, plumbing, accessibility hardware, ventilation, and drains.

steps.label: Inspect the restroom for overall condition, damage, lighting, signage, doors, and hardware.
Inspect toilets, urinals, sinks, faucets, drains, and exposed plumbing for leaks or improper operation.
Inspect partitions, grab bars, counters, mirrors, dispensers, and restroom fixtures for damage or loose components.
Inspect caulk, grout, flooring, and drains for deterioration, water issues, or odors.
Clean/inspect exhaust ventilation and verify proper operation.

templates.name: Stairwells
templates.description: Quarterly stairwell finishes, lighting, and handrail inspection.

steps.label: Inspect stairwells for condition, cleanliness, damage, lighting, signage, and handrails.
